summary.text: William D. Brisson is a Republican member of the North Carolina House of Representatives, representing District 22 (Bladen and Sampson counties), for the 2025-2026 session. The General Assembly's member page lists 10 terms served in the House.

paragraphs.text: The General Assembly's member page lists William D. Brisson's occupation as Farmer.
